dungeons_forming: Still forming: it takes a moment.
dungeons_unknown_kind: its kind ({0}) isn't in this version of Quad's Dungeons
dungeons_wait: {0} is still forming: you go in as soon as it's ready.
dungeons_holding: Hold on: the dungeon is still forming around you.
dungeons_sent_out: The dungeon didn't form: you are back at its entrance.
dungeons_rescued: There was nothing below you: you are back on the ground.
dungeons_map_keys: Floors: arrow keys or the wheel. Zoom: + and -, drag to look around. Close: {0} or Esc.
dungeons_map_upper: Upper part of a tall room
dungeons_map_drop: A drop to the floor below
dungeons_cracked_hint: A pickaxe or a heavy blow would break it
dungeons_vault_reward: The vault holds something for you: {0}
dungeons_item_trophy_warden_desc: The head of a giant vault's warden, still humming faintly. Hang it on an item stand.
dungeons_item_trophy_warden_lore: The giants built vaults deep under the world and left wardens to keep them. This one kept its vault until you came.
dungeons_item_giantcog_desc: A cog from a giant's vault machine, heavy and cut finer than any smith alive could manage. Keep it: its use will come.
dungeons_sync_version: Quad's Dungeons: the server has version {0}, you have {1}. Every player needs the server's version.
dungeons_sync_noserver: Quad's Dungeons is off on this server: the server doesn't have the mod (or has an old version). Dungeons can't be entered or made here.
dungeons_sync_failed: Quad's Dungeons: the server's dungeon packs didn't arrive, so dungeons can't be entered here. Reconnect to try again.
dungeons_off: Dungeons are off on this server
dungeons_pedestal_unfit: Only an item as it was found goes here: not upgraded, worn or marked
dungeons_brazier_needs: Hold a torch to light it
dungeons_checkpoint_saved: Checkpoint set: if you fall in here, you rise here
dungeons_pushblock_hint: Walk into it to push it
dungeons_key_small_desc: Opens one lock in the dungeon where it was found. It can't leave that dungeon.
dungeons_key_boss_desc: Opens the great door of the dungeon where it was found. It can't leave that dungeon.
dungeons_rebuilding: This dungeon is being built again: you're back at its entrance
dungeons_reloaded: Dungeon packs reloaded: {0} changed, {1} dungeons remade.
dungeons_act_takeover: Nobody answered for this dungeon: your game runs it now.
dungeons_act_lost: That didn't reach the dungeon. Try again.
dungeons_sync_peer_old: {0} needs to update Quad's Dungeons and rejoin (they have {1}, you have {2}).
dungeons_sync_peer_new: {0} has a newer Quad's Dungeons ({1}): update yours and load the world again.
dungeons_boss_warden_shield: {0} is shielded and can't be hurt: light both braziers together, twice! Each lever stands in a hammer's lane: pull it between the blows.
dungeons_boss_warden_p3: {0} recovers and is enraged: faster, harder-hitting, and it charges! (it tears itself free of the machine)
dungeons_boss_thrall_hint: Its iron hide turns your blows: lure it under the hammer (the black plate with the amber ring) and pull a lever beside it!
dungeons_boss_thrall_p2: {0} recovers and is enraged: faster and harder-hitting! (its gears grind faster)
dungeons_boss_shielded: {0} is shielded and can't be hurt: find what in the room breaks the shield!
dungeons_boss_shield_broken: The shield of {0} is broken: it can be hurt again!
dungeons_boss_shield_flicker: The shield of {0} still holds: do it again!
dungeons_boss_held: {0} is held in place: it's coming down on it!
dungeons_boss_warden_flicker: The shield of {0} still holds: light both braziers again!
dungeons_boss_thrall_held: {0} is chained in place: the hammer is coming down!
dungeons_boss_drowned_bellkeeper_hint: Lure it onto the planked mark under the great bell and pull a bell-rope lever beside it: the bell drops on it!
dungeons_boss_drowned_bellkeeper_p1: {0} rings the great bell back up and a drowned thrall answers!
dungeons_boss_drowned_bellkeeper_shield: {0} is shielded and can't be hurt: lure it onto the mark under the bell and pull a bell-rope lever!
dungeons_boss_drowned_bellkeeper_p2: {0} recovers and is enraged: faster, harder-hitting, and it rushes at you! (the bell's last toll drives it on)
dungeons_boss_drowned_bellkeeper_held: {0} is held in place: the bell is coming down!
dungeons_boss_drowned_jarl_hint: Lure him onto the planked mark under his anchor and pull a windlass lever beside it: the anchor drops on him!
dungeons_boss_drowned_jarl_p1: {0} calls the tide: the side aisles flood (they hurt when the green glow surges) and drowned thralls come!
dungeons_boss_drowned_jarl_shield: {0} is shielded and can't be hurt: shut both sluice gates together, twice! Their levers stand in the flooded aisles: pull them between the surges.
dungeons_boss_drowned_jarl_flicker: The shield of {0} still holds: the sluices burst open again! Shut both together once more.
dungeons_boss_drowned_jarl_p2: {0} recovers and is enraged: faster, harder-hitting, and he charges! (the tide floods back for good: take cover behind the risen stones)
dungeons_boss_drowned_jarl_held: {0} is held in place: the anchor is coming down!
dungeons_rimeforge_thaw_hint: An ice wall seals the way on. Get all three furnaces burning at once to melt it: pull each one's bellows lever (or light it with a torch). Each burns for only 14 seconds.
dungeons_rimeforge_thawed: The three furnaces roar together: the ice walls melt away!
dungeons_rimeforge_hammers_hint: Trip-hammers slam across the whole hall in turn: run through between the blows (each one rises and creaks before it falls). The lever at the far end stops them.
dungeons_boss_rimeforge_keeper_hint: Its frost-crusted hide turns your blows: lure it into a bellows lane (the scorched iron strip) and pull that bellows' lever! When it heaves at its chains, get out of the lanes.
dungeons_boss_rimeforge_keeper_p2: {0} recovers and is enraged: faster and harder-hitting, and the bellows blast every few seconds! (the forge-wind runs wild)
dungeons_boss_rimeforge_keeper_held: {0} is caught in the bellows' blast!
dungeons_boss_rimeforge_smith_hint: Its rime armour turns your blows: lure it under a falling press (the iron anvil-marks on the floor) to break its armour!
dungeons_boss_rimeforge_smith_heat: {0} stokes the forge: it is white-hot and can't be hurt, and the floor vent and falling slag burn! (the forge roars)
dungeons_boss_rimeforge_smith_shield: {0} is white-hot and can't be hurt: push the block of glacier ice down the channel into the forge's mouth, twice! (the lever by the channel calves a new block)
dungeons_boss_rimeforge_smith_flicker: {0} still glows: push another block of ice into the forge!
dungeons_boss_rimeforge_smith_p3: {0} plunges into the quench pool and recovers, enraged: faster and harder-hitting, and it charges! (its iron is tempered)
dungeons_rootdeep_seed_desc: A seed of the world-tree, warm and glowing. Put it in the root socket at the rot pit's edge. (It belongs to this dungeon and stays in it.)
dungeons_rootdeep_heartseed_desc: A seed from the Mother Root's pod. Put it in the root's mouth (the socket at the Mother Root's foot) to break the Sap-Warden's shield. (It belongs to this dungeon and stays in it.)
dungeons_rootdeep_seed_fell: A seed pod burst and dropped a glowing seed: carry it to the root's mouth!
dungeons_rootdeep_garden_seed: The pod ripened and dropped a glowing seed: put it in the socket at the pit's edge.
dungeons_rootdeep_garden_grown: The seed is drunk: a root bridge grows across the pit!
dungeons_boss_rootdeep_sapwarden_hint: Wear {0} down. When it goes back to drink from the root, carry the seed that falls across the hollow to the root's mouth!
dungeons_boss_rootdeep_sapwarden_p1: {0} goes back to the Mother Root to drink and can't be hurt! A seed pod bursts across the hollow.
dungeons_boss_rootdeep_sapwarden_shield: {0} is shielded and can't be hurt: carry the glowing seed to the root's mouth (the socket at the Mother Root's foot)!
dungeons_boss_rootdeep_sapwarden_p2: {0} recovers and is enraged: faster and harder-hitting, and it lashes at you along a marked lane! (the sap boils in it)
dungeons_boss_rootdeep_rotheart_title: The Rot at the Heart of the Tree
dungeons_boss_rootdeep_rotheart_hint: Wear {0} down. When it hides behind its rot-shield, burn the three rot-nodes at once!
dungeons_boss_rootdeep_rotheart_p1: The chamber closes in: the root walls are moving! {0} withdraws into its heart, shielded.
dungeons_boss_rootdeep_rotheart_shield: {0} is shielded and can't be hurt: burn all three rot-nodes at once! Pull the amber sap-bloom beside each (or use a torch or fire arrows); each burns 28 s.
dungeons_boss_rootdeep_rotheart_p2: {0} recovers and is enraged: faster and harder-hitting! The walls close in again, and it burrows at you along a marked lane.
dungeons_bonechoir_relic_bell_desc: A small bell from the Bell Tower. Lay it on the reliquary pedestal carved with a bell. It can't leave the dungeon it was found in.
dungeons_bonechoir_relic_skull_desc: The Choirmaster's skull. Lay it on the reliquary pedestal carved with a skull. It can't leave the dungeon it was found in.
dungeons_bonechoir_relic_bone_desc: A singer's bone from the Charnel. Lay it on the reliquary pedestal carved with a bone. It can't leave the dungeon it was found in.
dungeons_bonechoir_relic_bell_found: A relic fell by the tower's door: the bell relic. Take it to the Reliquary.
dungeons_bonechoir_relic_skull_found: The Choirmaster's skull is left on his lectern: the skull relic. Take it to the Reliquary.
dungeons_bonechoir_relic_bone_found: The bones settle into the grave, and the bone relic lies on the altar. Take it to the Reliquary.
dungeons_bonechoir_nave_hint: Ring the bell by the organ to start the procession of the dead. Bone spikes fall on the dark lanes: watch for the shudder.
dungeons_bonechoir_tower_hint: The bells ring a hymn by themselves. Pull their ropes in the same order to free the lift.
dungeons_bonechoir_tower_open: The hymn is right: the bells hold the counterweight. Step onto the lift!
dungeons_bonechoir_charnel_hint: Push the bone cart onto the open grave (walk into it). The lever by the door puts it back.
dungeons_bonechoir_reliquary_hint: Three relics open the reliquary: lay each on the pedestal carved with its likeness (a bell, a skull, a bone).
dungeons_bonechoir_reliquary_open: The three relics rest in their places: the reliquary's doors open.
dungeons_bonechoir_choirmaster_p1: {0} can't be hurt while a stall sings: drop the shutter on the lit stall (pull the lever beside it)!
dungeons_bonechoir_choirmaster_p2: Another stall takes up the song: {0} can't be hurt again. Silence the lit stall!
dungeons_bonechoir_choirmaster_shield: {0} is shielded by the lit stall's song: pull the lever beside that stall to drop its shutter!
dungeons_bonechoir_choirmaster_p4: {0} recovers and is enraged: faster and harder-hitting! (he sings alone now)
dungeons_bonechoir_colossus_hint: The choir's hymn shields {0}: when it sings, watch the order the bells ring in.
dungeons_bonechoir_colossus_p1: The choir sings {0} back to its mound: it can't be hurt! Pull the four bell ropes in the order the bells ring.
dungeons_bonechoir_colossus_shield: {0} is shielded by the hymn: watch the bells ring, then pull their ropes in the same order!
dungeons_bonechoir_colossus_hushed: The choir falls silent: the shield breaks!
dungeons_bonechoir_colossus_p2: A new verse in a new order: {0} is shielded again, and the great bells now send shockwaves along the dark lanes!
dungeons_bonechoir_colossus_p3: {0} recovers and is enraged: faster, harder-hitting, and it charges! (the whole choir screams)
dungeons_boss_starfall_keeper_title: Who Turns the Rings of the Sky
dungeons_boss_starfall_keeper_hint: Its star-iron hide turns your blows: lure it onto the pale ring in the floor as the lens above strikes (a red ring shows where)!
dungeons_boss_starfall_keeper_p2: {0} recovers and is enraged: faster and harder-hitting, and stars fall on you! (its rings race)
dungeons_boss_starfall_suneater_totality: Total eclipse: the lamps die and {0} is shielded on its dais! Turn the three sun-mirrors to throw their light onto it.
dungeons_boss_starfall_suneater_shield: {0} is shielded and can't be hurt: turn all three sun-mirrors with their cranks until each throws its light onto the dais, together, twice!
dungeons_boss_starfall_suneater_flicker: {0} shrugs off the light and knocks the mirrors askew: turn all three onto it again!
dungeons_boss_starfall_suneater_p3: {0} recovers and is enraged: faster and harder-hitting! (the moon passes over the sun again)
dungeons_starfall_orrery_hint: Turn the cranks to bring all three planets into line with the far door: then the moon-bridge rises. Each crank turns one, two or three planets; a planet lights up when it's in line.
dungeons_starfall_conjunction: The planets stand in line: the moon-bridge rises!
dungeons_starfall_chart_hint: Walk the constellation: step on its stars in order, starting by the fallen star and following the lines. Mind the falling stars!
dungeons_starfall_chart_done: The constellation is complete: the watchers' shades rise! Defeat them to open the way on.
